notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

It has been some time since the last update. The good news is that we have almost completed the fully illustrated version of Episode 1. Anna is currently working on the sketches for the illustrated version of the base game.

The bad news is that we still don't have a new playable version of the game. I understand that this is an inconvenient situation. However, the plan still is to implement the new version of the game in the not too distant future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43444244/5ad5e46d08f2368e7d02d2a5ea7b2ff4855b2cd5.jpg
I have also been working on the new content for the game and am proud to announce that Episode 2 (The Mylia Flower), Episode 3 (Guards of the Vale), and Episode 4 (The Forlorn Grove) are almost complete. 

I just need some more time to get things done properly.

In the meantime, you might want to take a look at the artwork section of the game.

 Artwork 

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

The year is drawing to an end. This is the time to give you an update on the game's development. To be honest, we didn't achieve our goal of implementing a new game engine for Aunewyth. The plan was to move from GameMaker to Unity. Yet we didn't get satisfying results so far. That's the bad news.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43444244/d5a6fc0b655201ce7ebfdd3fb534ec4b548bf198.jpg
But now for the good news. I have been working on the upcoming content for the game. The plan is to implement new content into the game in the not too distant future. Here is a list of what to expect.


Episode 1 - A Toad in the Swamp (already playable - continues the storyline after offending Adana)
Episode 2  - The Mylia Flower (almost complete - continues the storyline after just visiting Adana)
Episode 3 - Guards of the Vale (in the making - continues the storyline after meeting with Ackley)
Episode 4 - The Forlorn Grove (in the making - continues the storyline after talking to the elder)
Main Game - a new version of the game (in the making - contains all episodes plus the base game)

We are working on a fully illustrated version of Episode 1 and have completed over 80 illustrations so far. However, creating a fully illustrated game seems out of reach under the given circumstances. We have therefore decided to create partially illustrated versions of the other episodes and the base game for now.

As always, you are welcome to share your thoughts.

Feedback Thread

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

This update adds new content to the base game. 

It basically changes the beginning of the game so that the first six encounters now look (and feel) a little different to smoothen the overall experience. Furthermore, I changed the music for the starting screen.

The base game (Aunewyth Forest, Mountain Road, Purefire Path) should be fully playable.

There are up to four different epilogues depending on your choices. Thank you for your feedback.

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Community Feedback Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers. 

This is a small update to add new controls to the game. 

From now on, you may also use [W] and [S] to move through the game.

[Up] and [Down] can (as always) also be used to move through the game.

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

The new episode has been finished and is fully playable now.

A Toad in the Swamp will take you on a journey to a new area of Aunewyth Valley.

Introducing Adventure Mode, players will have to tread carefully to avoid biting the dust.

There will also be new ways of interacting with the environment to alter the outcome of the 
game. These interactions may vary with each playthrough depending on the choices you make.

Do you have the courage to embark on an unexpected journey full of hazard and adventure?

Buckle up and get ready for a toadally different experience.

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers. 

As you may have heard, there is a new episode in the making.

If you venture into Aunewyth Forest, there are basically two possible outcomes when meeting Adana.

Being the witch she is, Adana will (in a way) punish you if you misbehave and leave you in dire straits.

The new episode is supposed to let you experience the events that will unfold from this point on.

The plan is to release the new episode as a full content update consisting of roughly 30 encounters.

This may still take a while but I'm looking forward to completing the new episode in the near future.

Good luck on your journey!

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update - Part 2
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers. This small update brings some minor changes to the game, plus a new control panel for some encounters (Use [Up] to proceed instead of Use [Space] to proceed).

[Space] can be used to speed things up while [Up] will be used to continue single-decision encounters.

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers. This update changes the game's resolution from 720p (1280x720 pixels) to 1080p (1920x1080 pixels). I have been testing the new build of the game using different configurations. Everything worked fine so far. However, if you experience any issues, please just let me know.

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update

notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. This major update adds new content to the game. Mountain Road has become fully playable (encounter 15, encounter 16, encounter 17, encounter 18 have been added). There is also a new piece of music (Approaching Mist). Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Major Content Update

notes.title: Performance Update

notes.title: Small Content Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. This small update adds a new encounter (encounter 11 (Purefire Path)) and a new literary piece (Covenant Sanctum) to the game. The new priority is to add more content to the game. Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Small Content Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. This small update adds two new encounters to the game (encounter 13 and encounter 14 (Mountain Road)). The new priority is to add more content to the game. Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Community Feedback Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. This is just a small update to make sure the game has a proper end screen for the time being (Early Access). The game also starts (and restarts) a little faster now. Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. I have been receiving several requests from curators and other reviewers who want to take a closer look at Aunewyth. First of all, thank you so much for your interest in the game. I have been talking to people from all over the world. That's just amazing! Please let me know if you need a key.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. Aunewyth will be launching tomorrow. So I just wanted to give you a quick overview of what to expect from the game in its current state. Aunewyth features three locations. Aunewyth Forest will be fully playable while the other two locations (Mountain Road and Purefire Path) remain unfinished.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. With the launch date closing in, I'm doing my best to improve the game. As you may know, Aunewyth is a game with a focus on decision making. And from now on, players will be able to change their decision within a few seconds.
